units: <cite ref="Megillah 15a:20">Meg. 15ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מביא ג׳ לעולם</he> causes redemption to come (through his good deeds).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:2">Cant. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>בגְאוּלַּת מחר</he> of to-morrow’s redemption, i.e. Messianic days.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 15b:8">Kidd. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>גאולת עצמו</he> redemption from service by himself, <he>ג׳ קרובים</he> by relatives, <he>ג׳ אחרים</he> by strangers (<cite ref="Leviticus 25:47">Lev. XXV, 47</cite> sq.).

<cite ref="Pesachim 118a:7">Pes. 118ᵃ</cite> <he>מן הג׳</he> than delivery (from evil); a. fr. [<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32">Lev. R. s. 32</cite>, end; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:1">Koh. R. to IV, 1</cite>, read <he>גּוֹאֲלָהּ</he>, v. <cite ref="C00266"><he>גּוֹאֵל</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>גְּאוּלּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:5:5">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שתי ג׳</he> two redemptions (of fruits).

senses.gloss: that section of the prayers between the Sh’ma (<cite ref="U01512"><he>שְׁמַע</he></cite>) and the T’fillah (<cite ref="V00831"><he>תְּפִלָּה</he></cite>), so called from its contents.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 9b:21">Ber. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>סמך ג׳ לתפלה</he> he recited the T’fillah immediately after closing the G’ullah (with the benediction <he>גאל ישראל</he>).
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: the seventh benediction of the T’fillah, prayer for redemption.
